'''Ice troll grunts''' are the foot soldiers of the [[Ice Troll King]] on the isles of [[Jatizso]] and [[Neitiznot]]. [[Yak-hide armour]] reduces the troll's maximum hit and therefore is recommended over armour with higher defensive bonuses.

==Trivia==
* Players who have done the [[Fremennik Isles]] quest can make their own [[yak-hide armour]] using items easily obtained on [[Neitiznot]]. This armour is very inexpensive and has good damage-stopping properties against trolls.
